bio: The picturesque Gasthaus am Brunnen sits in the centre of this Graubünden mountain village. Locals meeting for lunch or a drink favour the rustic dining room, while the smart, minimalist-style restaurant is more elegant. The food is modern and uses exclusively local produce. Try the veal tenderloin cooked on a rock salt slab and served with herb caviar, mustard and garlic risotto and vegetables. The female chef's desserts are delicious....
